items.title: All 12 Months! 📅 Riddle #20 Answer + Riddle #21: Which Way Does the Rooster's Egg Roll? 🐓 #shorts

qa.heard: Yesterday's riddle. Some months have 31 days, some have 30. How many months have 28 days?  The February is not the only one. Every single month has at least 28 days.  So all 12 months have 28 days. The answer is 12. Now, a brand new mystery.  Person 1 watches a rooster climb up to the very top of a barn roof.  The rooster lays an egg right on the peak. Will the egg roll down the left side or the right  side? Person 2 says, left person 3 says, right. So, which way does the egg roll?  Comment your answer. The answer drops tomorrow at sunrise.

items.title: Achhi Baat Kaho Ya Khamosh Raho | Padosi, Mehmaan, Zabaan | Sahih Bukhari 6018 #shorts

qa.salutation: Sahil's recorded clip spliced via <SAW> (fixed audio; whisper cannot confirm 'Wa Aalihi')
qa.heard: زبان ایک ہے مگر کتنی بار ہم نے اس سے کسی کا دل دکھایا۔  عزت ابو حررا رزی اللہ آن ہو سے روایت ہے کہ  حمارِ نبی محمد مصطفہ صل اللہ تعال عالیہ و عالیہ و صل اللہ  نے فرمایا جو اللہ اور آخرت کے دن پر ایمان رکتا ہے  وہ اپنے پڑوسی کو تقلیف نہ دے جو اللہ اور آخرت کے دن پر ایمان رکتا ہے  وہ اپنے محمان کی عزت کرے اور جو اللہ اور آخرت کے دن پر ایمان رکتا ہے  وہ اچھی بات کہیں یا خاموش رہے  گسے میں تیز جواب رکیں پہلے سوچیں  یہ بات اچھی ہے اگر نہیں تو خاموش رہنا ہی بہتر ہے  کمٹ میں لکھیں یا اللہ ہماری زبان کو خیر کا ذریعہ بنا  یہ ویڈیو آگے بھیجے یہ بھی ایک اور صدقہ ہے

items.label: kids
items.title: Share Your Lunch! 🥪 Food for Two Is Enough for Three | Islam for Kids #shorts

qa.salutation: Sahil's recorded clip spliced via <SAW> (fixed audio; whisper cannot confirm 'Wa Aalihi')
qa.heard: Oh, my friend forgot his lunch today, but my lunch is only for me. Or is it?  Listen, our Prophet Muhammad Mustafa  sallallahu ta'ala alaihi wa a'ala alihi wa sallam  taught us food for two is enough for three and food for three is enough for four  I break my sandwich in half one half for me and one half for you  Then another friend sits down with us. We share the apple slices, too  Look everybody has enough and everybody is smiling and we share there is blessing in our food  It feels like more, not less. Who will you share with tomorrow? Tell your grown-up
qa.second_check_notes: Verified by WebFetch of sunnah.com/bukhari:5392: narrator Abu Huraira; 'The food for two persons is sufficient for three, and the food of three persons is sufficient for four' (Book 70 Hadith 20). Narration and on-screen 'Food for 2 = enough for 3!' match. 'When we share, there is blessing in our food' is the narrator's explanatory lesson, not put in the Prophet's mouth, and it is the standard understanding of this hadith (barakah through sharing), so it is a fair framing and not fabricated. Salutation is Sahil's clip (whisper: 'our Prophet Muhammad Mustafa sallallahu ta'ala alaihi wa ... alihi wa sallam'). Real aerial Green Dome footage at 5-17 s (Pixabay 198164, credited). Voice: voice_run_id 45318924763; 17 silences, so no music. Only ordinary children and a mum are drawn; no halos, no spinning text, nothing haram. selfDeclaredMadeForKids true, public, title 77 chars. Nits (non-blocking): ~2.8-4.8 s the opening lunchbox lid is drawn as a thin pale-orange rod with a red dot between the boys, which reads like a stray stick or broken arm, and the lunch inside is not visible; ~21 s the girl walks in half off-frame (fine as an entrance). | After review: fixed the reviewer's non-blocking nits (riddle leap-year wording; Sadqah TAANA/GAALI bursts moved above heads; kids lunchbox redrawn on top in teal) and re-checked those frames; qa_check re-run PASS.
